description: Get a floating estimate for a route and amount: amountTo, networkFee (taken out of the payout), receiveAmount (what arrives after that fee) and rate. Use it to tell a person what they would receive or to size a create_swap. Not for the allowed range (get_limits) and it creates nothing. The estimate is not a reservation: the final amount is set when the deposit confirms, and a quote read later may differ. With mode=private the response carries legs[] for the two legs.

amount.description: decimal amount you send, as a string, within get_limits

from.description: asset slug you send, e.g. usdt-trc20

mode.description: standard (default), or private: the swap runs as two legs at two providers through an intermediate coin; the response then carries mode, via and legs[]

rateType.description: floating (default): an estimate settled when the deposit confirms; fixed: a held amount under a rateId for about a minute to create the swap with, then the order's own deposit deadline (payTill)

to.description: asset slug you receive, e.g. btc

via.description: private mode only: slug of the intermediate coin; omitted → the server picks among sol, trx, ltc; xmr on request (Untraceable mode: the hop runs on Monero)

name: get_quote
title: Live quote
